title: phillyrea vulgaris var. angustifolia
intro: Phillyrea vulgaris var. angustifolia, commonly known as narrow-leaf mock privet, is a plant species in the family Oleaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Mediterranean region, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues and soothe digestive problems. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Phillyrea vulgaris var. angustifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
